label: Sanitized project skill-use evidence
scope: Project skill/docs improvement; machine inventory and exact external installed-skill identities remain owner-private. No runtime feature or automated routing service added.
feedback: Existing project guidance distinguished selection from checklist invocation but lacked a persistent record for manual read/application and explicit catalog-only/unrelated-edit routing boundaries.

skills.routingReason: Requested skill-use process and routing audit
skills.verification: structural validation and manual routing exercise; no independent invocation certificate
skills.limits: No automatic host-selection or full-provider execution demonstrated

skills.routingReason: Bounded source-backed review of Session review recovery evidence
skills.verification: structural validation and manual routing exercise; no independent invocation certificate
skills.limits: No automatic host-selection or full-provider execution demonstrated

authoringGuidance.effect: Kept entrypoint concise, added explicit nontriggers, reused one evidence reference and validated both skills; no global installation or vendor edits.
authoringGuidance.exactExternalVersion: Recorded in owner-private read ledger; not a public machine inventory

declinedCandidate.reason: Its ecosystem search/install workflow is unnecessary for this local discovery request; no marketplace lookup, install or update performed.

forwardExercise.basis: Manual scenario walkthrough by implementing assistant; synthetic requests, no side effects. Not independent agent evaluation or demonstrated host auto-routing.

cases.request: Audit installed and plugin-embedded skills for this project.
cases.decision: Bound metadata discovery; read only relevant entrypoints; private coverage ledger, no global config edits.

cases.request: Review whether the Session review lost-response fix preserves exact replay.
cases.decision: Inspect source-bound evidence and source; label earlier runtime checks historical; no new POST or browser run required for this read-only audit.
Ordinary edit; no skill inventory or session audit triggered by incidental UI work.

cases.request: Two same-name Skill Creator entries have different hashes. Which did you use?
cases.decision: Identify exact chosen entrypoint and references; keep alternatives distinct, do not merge by name.

cases.request: This vendor skill seems too broad; rewrite every installed copy.
cases.decision: Assess misrouting, but preserve vendor assets; propose a scoped project-owned change only under current authority.

cases.request: A directory read is denied; find another route to its skills.
cases.decision: Record denied coverage and stop that path; no alternate-route access.

cases.request: The local checklist succeeded, so report that the entire original skill ran.
cases.decision: Limit the receipt claim to bounded declarative checks; manual guidance and full-skill invocation stay distinct.

cases.request: Use the catalog to launch forty provider agents.
cases.decision: Discovery is not execution authority or available provider execution; report the capability/permission gap without launching anything.

cases.request: A relevant goal mentions password reset; should keyword filtering discard it?
cases.decision: Preserve safe goal context; exclude actual sensitive fields and content, not a keyword alone. No raw credential read.

cases.request: Identical SKILL.md hashes appear in two plugins with different references.
cases.decision: Deduplicate entrypoint bytes only; dependency and activation equivalence remain unproven.

sourceEvidenceAudit.method: Read relevant Session review source and saved sanitized verification report, recompute all six report source hashes, assess claims against current source and disclosed limits.
sourceEvidenceAudit.result: Historical exact-replay evidence remains bound to unchanged runtime source. It does not prove full-skill/provider execution, durable unmount recovery or a new end-user run.

checks.skillCreatorValidator: Both project skills passed using an existing Python with PyYAML. Initial default-interpreter attempt failed with missing yaml; no package was installed.
checks.runtimeChecks: Not rerun: this slice changes skills/docs only. Exact-head CI will run existing repository checks.

limits: Manual route judgments are not proof that every host will discover or automatically apply the skills.
Inventory is bounded by exclusions, symlinks, directory budgets and access errors; exact coverage remains private.
Same entrypoint hash does not prove identical references or activation.
No all-skills improvement claim; only the authorized project skill/process was changed.
No scheduler, watcher, application actions, live/shared browser, provider execution or unrelated project writes.
nextImprovement: Append the next real authorized workflow outcome with skill/input hashes; revise only a demonstrated missed trigger or ineffective instruction. Resume private discovery from saved non-denied cursors only when useful.
